title: Months since joining
statementMd:
For the five customers who joined most recently show name and months between joining and 2024-06-30 (days / 30.44, rounded down). Ties by name.

Expected columns: `name`, `months`.

Tables: `customers`, `accounts`, `transactions`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT name, CAST((julianday('2024-06-30') - julianday(joined)) / 30.44 AS INTEGER) AS months FROM customers ORDER BY joined DESC, name LIMIT 5;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
